purpose: Prove point-in-time membership, timestamp and geometry concordance between archived runtime observations and a delayed, separately fetched native-timeframe replay before a new event-feature shadow experiment may even be registered

preflight_finding.interpretation: The rejected 2020-2026 event models remain non-promotable. Numeric tolerances must not be loosened to hide object-presence and missingness differences. Prospective concordance uses delayed native-timeframe re-fetches; any later model needs a new data contract consistent with that runtime representation.

independent_replay_source.timestamp_semantics: native candle-open UTC converted to completed-close UTC before replay
independent_replay_source.reference_surplus_purpose: Retain the exact 200-bar runtime window when a decision is replayed after up to one completed trading day; the comparator still tails 200 bars at each decision
independent_replay_source.reference_cutoff: current UTC midnight, fetched after the cutoff so every included candle is complete
independent_replay_source.independence_limit: Runtime and replay both use Dukascopy and the same frozen detector implementation. The replay is a separate delayed network fetch of all five native timeframes and tests source revision, timestamp alignment, membership and feature values; it is not independent economic information or an independently implemented detector.

comparison_contract.decision_scope: Every successful runtime scan at or after collection_starts_at_utc whose decision time is covered by a valid delayed native reference snapshot
comparison_contract.runtime_replay: Recompute each archived runtime snapshot and require exact scan membership and journal identity before comparing the delayed reference
comparison_contract.historical_replay: At the next completed UTC-day collection, separately re-fetch 400 complete native bars for all five timeframes, then slice the exact 200-bar runtime window causally at each covered runtime decision time
comparison_contract.membership_match: Exact stable event-ID set equality at each covered decision time

authorization_gates.pass_effect: Only establishes technical eligibility to register a separate prospective shadow experiment; it does not authorize feature use, a model, Claude input, candidate approval, notification, paper trade or broker order

change_rule: Any source, archive, timestamp, replay cadence, membership, feature, tolerance, sample-size, isolation or authorization change requires a new hash-locked concordance contract
